scope.counting_unit: serialized node occurrence; functions + hidden + per-program init; runtime_hex excluded

limitations: Static occurrence counts are not dynamic execution counts or reachability proofs.
Raw par16/par8 values are reported; only actionInfoTable parameter count defines which operand bytes are meaningful.
Adjacent nodes are serialized neighbors within one segment, not confirmed control-flow or stack-value provenance.
Counts do not determine container types, alias visibility, reference lifetimes, or assignment semantics.
Same logical library compiled into multiple service packages is counted once per packaged occurrence.
Offsets are decompressed member-relative byte offsets, not ELF virtual addresses.
